title: Senior Associate - Corporate Law
description: We are seeking a Senior Associate to join our Corporate Law practice in New Delhi. The ideal candidate will have 4-6 years of experience in corporate transactions, including M&A, joint ventures, and general corporate matters.
responsibilities: Lead due diligence efforts on complex transactions
Advise clients on corporate governance matters
Manage client relationships and develop business
requirements: 4-6 years of corporate law experience at a reputable law firm
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: Legal Intern
description: We are looking for motivated final-year law students for our litigation team. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in drafting and research.
responsibilities: Conduct legal research on case laws
Assist in drafting petitions and applications
requirements: Final year law student or fresh graduate
